translation: ɗum wonataa fii maaɗa muusere wootere wootere wootere wootere wootere wootere wootere wootere, woto nde laatu mudda wonande joomi am, woto ƴoolaa ƴiiƴam meere, kono joomi am daɗndu hoore mum; Yaawe waɗana joomi am moƴƴere, maaɗa wattitoo⟨e⟩ hetta laawnere wootere: a waɗataa ɗum fii maaɗa muusere wootere, wanaa nguuba wonande ɓernde joomi am, woto laɓɓitoo ƴiiƴam meere, kono joomi am daɗnu hoore mun; Yaawe waɗana joomi am moƴƴere, maa wattitirta ⟨את⟩ bidɗo maaɗa.
